steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The scent.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Fluid without the scent of seawater. Foul nutritional fluid, or completely scentless distilled water. It maddens, drives mad.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The noise.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: There is no singing. There is no dancing. Only an endless, drawn-out clamoring remains. A horrific murmur, bringing craze.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's not all like that. Sometimes, in the momentarily returned quiet, there are voices to hear too. Clear voices.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Is it 'I' who hears them? Not for sure. How should 'I' respond? Not important.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: This ragged, dilapidated body... here and now lacks, beyond maintaining silence, any use.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...Shark... no... Lauren... Laurentina!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't rush, Skadi. You're far more familiar with her past than I am. But as for her present, you do not necessarily know her more thoroughly than I do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I know you've been emotionally excited by the prospect of seeing one of your colleagues, but do not make contact with her. Her slumber is the product of tremendous effort.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Shark... Shark of the Second. It really is you.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You're still alive... I'm not the only Abyssal Hunter still alive...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course you're not.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I wandered dry land for so many years, and she was the first one I ever saw. Rhodes Island, exactly how did you find her?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A deal, of no small cost, but thankfully enough for me to find out where the Church hid her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When we brought her back, she still held the last of her clarity, but very rapidly fell into confusion.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Shark... can you not hear my voice? You should still remember me... no matter if it's me with you, or you with me, there's still so much for us to talk about.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But in her conversations with us... while her confusion hasn't relapsed, she only calls herself 'Specter.'

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: 'Specter?' She wasn't called that before. She's an Abyssal Hunter, one of the fiercest, cruelest 'executioners' of the Second...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But she is presently Specter. Infected, has fled the Church of the Deep, and proclaims herself 'Specter.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Skadi, no matter her past, in her final waking moments, this is all as she told me. As to her capacity as an Abyssal Hunter, she mentioned not even a word.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Why...?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Shark... no, Specter. She was taken away by a church on the land? They must have carried out so many cruel experiments on her.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: They wanted to learn the secrets... Specter's secrets, the Abyssal Hunters' secrets. And you...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Isn't that your reason too?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You know this is no easy topic. But exactly as per my attitude regarding you, the Abyssal Hunters' secrets are in no way the ultimate truth I seek to learn.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I regard Specter the same way. She is first and foremost my patient, and then one of Rhodes Island's personnel. As for anything prior—anything she hasn't mentioned before, I have no need to investigate deeper.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I want to ask... when she'll wake up.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Keeping an empty nest only wastes time. That miniscule chance of a miracle is not something you'd be willing to stop in your own tracks for.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We are sustaining her life. Her outlook is neutral; whether or not she can recover entirely depends on her. Here on dry land, this is all we can accomplish.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'll come back.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I want to meet her, speak with her, hear her singing. I've already... we've already been apart from our colleagues for far too long.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your and her callings, significances at Rhodes Island are not the same. But provided she awakens, Skadi, she should be able to address your and my confusions alike.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope... we won't have to wait too long.
Somewhere outside Sal Viento

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Are we still hanging back, Captain? That's Skadi. She won't NOT find the way.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: No harm in waiting. She's more familiar with Rhodes Island's other operators.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I see now. Aaaaall you need is to make a deal with Dame Kal'tsit, and that's why she's the only one you got in touch with.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But I've been stuck in there for ages. There's so much that can take the same answer, and be done the same way.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The situation is provisionally stable, but not completely secured. When the time comes, either myself or Skadi will be confirming whether we can take you back.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hah. I'm not withered enough to collapse before I make it to Rhodes Island. Yet.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: On that note, Captain, do you have any idea what kind of place it is? They don't even have auto-flush smart toilets!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: So I'm not aaaaall in a hurry to get back to that landship. Skadi's got her worries to settle, and we can chit-chat over ours.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Speak what you feel.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Saying this now might be way, way too late... But I can't help but say it. Captain, relax. I haven't leaked anything about us to anyone, not once, not ever.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Those Church idiots wanted to find our secrets. They tried prising open my mouth, digging the words out from inside my throat.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I wasn't willing. Then they went and thought to find any hint, whisper, indication from within my flesh, from inside my brain. But... you've seen where that got them.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: They never got their wish.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I saw. Were this the past, I would have to honor you... but at present, no one has the qualifications to do it for you, to officially and formally assess your conduct.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: No, Captain, you have those qualifications. Let's go back to the past for just a bit... we both have the memories to talk the talk.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Very well, then. Shark... your judgment was proper. You protected our secrets with your life. Very well done.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heh... hah, hahah, that soothes me.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Nothing else from me, Captain. I suppose you got to know everything going on with me all by yourself. It's a stupidly drier tale than what you've dealt with.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I just want to know, actually. If it's not you skittering everywhere by yourself, but rather 'us' now...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The Abyssal Hunters, back together again. What will we get up to, then?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: My mission has never changed. But, Shark, who are you now?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Those dry-landers aboard Rhodes Island all say it, let alone Dame Kal'tsit. Now, even Skadi calls you 'Specter.'

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You have chosen to accept this identity, and have had no need to continue being 'Shark.'

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I'm still same as ever, Captain... I do something when I can do it. I have others to think about the rest for me. I'm Laurentina, I'm Shark, and I'm Specter.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Not a bad way to be.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And is there nothing else? Captain, it's been so long since we saw each other, we've gone through so much. Why did it take so few words for us to become like we were before?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But you never did care about much. Same then, same now.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: There is something. But you have no need to recall it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Something you want to know? What is it, then?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: When were you captured?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: On dry land. I broke free of those monsters, chased up onto shore, and while I was totally spent, those 'spirits' clasped me.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: So... you ultimately know nothing of the remaining hunters who were dragged to the bottom of the sea.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Right. Everyone scattered.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Captain, if all that remains of the Abyssal Hunters are us three now...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Even so, we are still Abyssal Hunters. Our blood leaves us no escape from it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: That's true, I knew you'd say something like that. Believe me, I wouldn't run from my mission.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Weird. Who in the hell's Skadi meeting for this long of a chat? Sal Viento's turned into a real wreck these days. Like there's anything to keep her here.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It seems of the Abyssal Hunters who walk on dry land, she has changed the most, and undertaken more besides.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Landwalkers' emotions, hah. It stuns me how accustomed she is to living out of water. And all the connections she's worked up.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Utterly meaningless. But to you, it is not a way of life necessarily ruled out, Shark.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I get it, I get it. If they really can figure out how to cure my case of bad-mouth, I'll reconsider my lifestyle.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But right now, my top priority is to reminisce, shoot the breeze.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: My weapon's duller than it was, my body's heavier than it used to be, and my reactions have slowed some too. If I'm going to be of real help to you, it'll take a bit more time.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: *sigh*... Forget it! Skadi's taking forever to come back anyway, so let's take a break. Oh, I'm dying to sing. Captain, who's going first?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Through all those mad, chaotic, inescapable days of pain, I would've gladly even given up my ability to fight, if only I could just sing.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But in the end, shock and horror, that was the one thing I somehow couldn't do.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's been too long... years, at this point. Does my throat still remember how to even hum? Let's try it and see.

a.text: When she prayed♪
The stars ceased to shimmer♪
And when she wept♪
The night let out a smile♪

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Captain... Specter.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Done with your conversation?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Yes. It's all sorted.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You and the landwalkers find so much to talk about. What are you teaching them? Are you telling them the ocean's knowledge, maybe passing on the dance and song?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It's not important now... I didn't tell them any of that.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You're lying. Hahah, Skadi, you're lying to cover them! You care so much about them!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I bet you've sung, or danced, or at least taught them how to scrounge up something edible from the shore, like what the Ægir of the sea would eat...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Shark.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I've been dying to report it to you, Captain. Skadi's changed massively. She keeps coming to my room, singing songs, telling stories.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The uptight little idiot, laying the tragedy of that entire disaster all on herself. All because she fought the Ægir's miserable destiny head-to-head?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'm not.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Let's go, Skadi. She's spent too long not talking. She won't stop now.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Of course, I've got so much more I want to say. But I can let you have the first word, Skadi. When I can't open my eyes, or move my body, I can still hear your voice. You've asked me leagues of questions.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Some of them... are no longer important.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Some truths have already been revealed.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: As for you... Specter, I have thought of asking you before. But I should not expose those emotions to you... at least, right now I shouldn't.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Not like it matters much. If you think of anything at all, talk to me, no holds barred, Skadi. But...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...I recommend you do it before the dark descends once more... the 'spirits' still have life...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Specter, did you just...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Tch. Nothing major. Just a godawful old habit.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Really? If those ideas that maddened you are polluting your thoughts once again, then we have to hurry back immediately.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: What use would hurrying back be? Medical systems on dry land do absolutely nothing for me. They keep me alive, and that's it.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Regardless, pick up the pace.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Shark, Skadi. Our time is not so plentiful.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hahah. Skadi, is this what you're thinking? Three estranged, adrift old friends are back together again, but we get something so simple and perfunctory for it?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: No. I only wanted to confirm the actual situation.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hah, 'actual.' What's the point? Abyssal Hunters only communicate what they need to know with each other. This is how we have always been, fundamentally.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's started up again... inside my head, within my spine, something's stirring outwards. It hurts...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It took so much to break out... and now I'm right back on the way to madness. Hahah, what else can I even do? In this hellish state, do I have anything worth doing?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Mm... right... what can I get done?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Fighting. Right, that's the one.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Sawing a thing or two apart is what I'm best at. Something I can do no matter my state.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Even if I fall into darkness once more, I can still rely on this... as proof of myself. I fight. So I am Specter, I am Shark, I am Laurentina. There'll be those who remember me.
Northern Iberia

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: If we go by Dame Kal'tsit's plans, our support should be right here, right now. Misery, was that the name?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But I don't see one single person who looks like Rhodes Island. How'd this happen?

steps.name: Liaison Operator
steps.text: Do you copy? Skadi, Specter, and Lady Gladiia.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Liaison Operator
steps.text: I'm with Misery's squad.

steps.name: Liaison Operator
steps.text: The fact that we made contact means we can't be far from each other. We're very sorry we didn't show up at the appointed position, but Rhodes Island's Iberia field team has run into some trouble.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Dame Kal'tsit isn't one to allow such error under her control.

steps.name: Liaison Operator
steps.text: Undoubtedly. This accident was beyond her plans. There was an ambush, and we can't confirm the Rhodes Island team's status... to borrow your words, it's one of those 'pains of dry land.'

steps.name: Liaison Operator
steps.text: Captain Misery says once it's sorted out, we'll rendezvous.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: How long will it take?

steps.name: Liaison Operator
steps.text: Hmm... two hours, if we rush over. We're the closest to you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: We're going to sit here and wait? Unacceptable. Captain, why don't we just—

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: This is not an operation we have any choice in. I and Rhodes Island have not formally established cooperation yet.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Yeah, yeah... Skadi, what do you think? How would the Rhodes Island operator in you take it?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: With... the lift of a finger.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Great minds think alike.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Your attitudes towards the people on dry land have come to resemble each other.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Then give it a go, Captain, join in the fun. We've all got the same objective, anyhow. If it gets us back to Rhodes Island sooner, what's the harm in helping a little along the way?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Also, how long has it been since we last fought together? That battle just now could hardly scratch the itch.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Even if... Fine, I can imagine facing off with land idiots won't take much effort. It probably wouldn't even leave the slightest wound.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You two. One only ever says what she has to, the other skirts and sidesteps and never wants to say what's weighing on her mind. You suffocate me, both of you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Forget it, I'm making the call! Rhodes Island, heads up, we'll come and provide support. We'll clean up the battlefield faster that way.

steps.name: Liaison Operator
steps.text: From what Dame Kal'tsit told us, you three have been through a fierce battle. Are you going to go jump straight into a new one?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hah, it's only a bit of a wake-up for us. She could never hold sway over our choices. And say what you like, our verdict's unanimous.

steps.name: Liaison Operator
steps.text: —I need to confirm, this is a sign you're willing to provide us assistance?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It'll only be the lift of a finger.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I have no interest in aiding any wave of landwalkers. I am even antipathic. However, nor will I have any guilt in destroying the other wave.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Our stance is very clear, Rhodes Islanders.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: There's no time... Ah, the lure of the darkness, it encroaches step by step.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh, 'Sister,' heed my command, respond to my hope, scatter the true essence of my mind forth...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hk—*cough*, *hack*... stop!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Specter? It's happening again, you're...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: No... hah... hahah... don't you pity me.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'm not... I'm just worried.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I know what you're afraid of... Skadi. The hourglass really is flowing far too fast... but I can still hold on.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: But forget any of that... we're the survivors. We've got so much we can take our time with, talk about...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's not the time to talk about any of that. And besides, we're Abyssal Hunters, Skadi. Sharing our experiences might be exciting, but it's not quite the point.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Just like before, Abyssal Hunters' communication—comes through song and battle. That's the most important thing.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Captain, you don't pay much mind in battle, do you?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Right. If you say you're fine, I will not ask further.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: That's the ticket. Let's go. Let me fight sober once again... it's been long, this self-determined joy.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: *cough*... hrgh—*cough*...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Are you alright there, Specter?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: (Waves hand)

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You're already... in terrible shape. Where are you going now?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heheh... where am I headed... right. Before time's up, I still have to hand in that holiday assignment you arranged for me.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You had me receive those 'kindnesses' for the landwalkers' Christmas. Apart from a cut-and-bone-dry gift... don't tell me you weren't meaning for me to gain some other, extra sentiments?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I had no other motive... I just didn't want you to miss it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hah, the others don't know what you used to be like... but me and the Captain know who you really are.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You've changed too much, Skadi. Your heart... is much too soft—even a landwalker can warm it. That's why you tried to return the favor.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Then what about you? You were snatched away by the Church... and rescued by Rhodes Island, and now you've united with your colleagues once again. How do you look upon this dry land?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Me? Hm... Aside from revulsion, contempt and ridicule for those Church plankton worshipping the sea, I've never had much serious talk with the people of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You know, they have no idea how to take in what I say, and they'd never understand Ægir life. They wouldn't have the first clue about the simple tools we use every day.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Rhodes Island? In terms of living life... it's a pain, a pain in the ass!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I won't argue that.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But there are places where their hearts and ours might agree.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Yes... vast creation's master, in the darkness, spies on it all alike...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It seeks, it coaxes... it will herein once again descend... ugh...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Specter, can you... still walk?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: (...I don't have much time.)

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Forget it. Let's drop it, Skadi, we talked enough on the way back, and I've still got a few things I need to see through.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Also... those 'never met,' or those landwalkers I've only seen once. I guess I should meet them one last time, in the end.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If you need me to help, then.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hah, don't bother. With two Abyssal Hunters walking side by side, how would those landbound asses not piss themselves in awe?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I'll leave the very last of my strength for the idiots of the land... however many I can meet... will be however many who can remember me. Ah, but what's the goddamned point?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: In the end, it's like Dame Kal'tsit says. It's only 'cause I'm needed that I'm still here, alive.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Or maybe... hm.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Dame Kal'tsit mentioned it. How I had those 'new friends.'

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Friends? The land people...? Hah.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: In any case, if I don't meet them in person, greet them directly, then I'll never know peace.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Off I go.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Yes... Off you go.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You'll wake once again, Specter... I'll be there then.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Don't beat yourself up so much. Skadi, quit frowning, I've never blamed you, not even once.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I know... I really do know.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Smile! I've accepted how I'm powerless to wake up. It's about time you accept your own past and present.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: If I really do awaken again, when you see me, let's chat about the more interesting things in life.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yo, you guys are back early.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Why'd you only call me? I thought the info Captain Gladiia or Skadi brought back would be more important.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That's 'stuff for after' important. To Rhodes Island, getting you checked out and treated is more important at the moment. We deliberated on it, and that's the call.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Of course, Kal'tsit's warned us about it a million times too.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Don't you care about her...?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Kal'tsit? That was her own decision. Besides, how do you know if she told me things would turn out this way?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: All these little schemes you landwalkers have really lose themselves in the details. Bo-ring.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Majorly glad to see you with the gift of gab, Specter. Misery told me how you three Abyssal Hunters helped a Rhodes Island field team out of a pinch.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Me and Skadi are registered, after all, and the other one'll be right on her way in to report.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So... how do you feel?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We need to run an evaluation on your combat strength.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: If you can hold onto your clear mind and run some combat in order against a team, we'll be real happy to draw you up some mission arrangements again.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hah. Your 'tests' really are far too simple, then. What makes that bunch of goons worth three Abyssal Hunters taking them on at once?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: When we got there, Misery already saved the show, more or less.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Dull like nothing else. I'd even take that damned mutant bishop. Oh, shame it's already dead.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It was I who personally returned it to the darkness... such darkness, a darkness still behind me, pursuing me...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hah... hahah... who could ever escape... the thirst to be one again with we many...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Specter? You still holding up there?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Ugh... not too well. But probably.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Your nervous system's getting attacked hard, and quicker than I expected. Let's get your examination on the road now...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: No... I'll just be back on that bed in the end, either way. I want to make use of this time. I still have my own things I want to do.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Knew it... Kal'tsit told me, don't force you to stop... she was able to figure your current state and choices.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But still, Rhodes Island's got a few questions for you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hah, then you'll need to be quick.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: How much longer will you be awake?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Couldn't say... my head's all hazy dazy. I might have about fifty percent consciousness?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright. I hope we can get everything out of you with these statements, and Rhodes Island will do all we can to respect your wishes.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Specter, when you first came to Rhodes Island, you did not make it in time to convey the message you wanted. Do you intend on conveying it now?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: There's no need... Closure, is that what they call you? What I needed to convey, my colleagues have already come to learn.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: As for the leftovers, though... I won't allow those strains that the church pawns planted in my will to flower, to spread those obscenities to places farther, wider still.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright. Next up, Rhodes Island took you in for treatment, and then with great caution sent you into field combat. Do you consider...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I know all that. It was my own choice to fight. Dame Kal'tsit figured out that much, and I still need to give her a little thanks for that.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The battlefield... is a peaceful place. At times, the silent ruins are much quieter than all that medical equipment, constantly whirring away.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: If, and I mean if, Specter, regarding recovery of your awareness... if we find a way to maintain your waking state to a certain degree, do you have any plans made for your future?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Plans? I've long since had those ready.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I was thinking about them on the trip back, even.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Why not invite the Captain and Skadi to form a team of three with me, go outside just for a spot of slaughter, and bully your useless land-dwelling punk idiots a little.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Skadi says after so long walking on land, she can tell apart the 'good' and the 'bad' in your hearts. With the Captain leading, we three are a complete army.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: For sure, if we consider what we know of the Abyssal Hunters' strength...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: However, I haven't told them any of that.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Dame Kal'tsit's warned me, and I've had inklings myself. This sanity is something that can't last for long.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: A three-person team fails at the planning stage. My combat style is already totally unlike how it used to be. Rhodes Island, the tactics you currently choose for me seem to be the most optimal.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Before we can find a way to treat you...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Forget it. All this dry-land technology of yours could only ever give me occasional peace.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The faults in my body... only I myself can sort them out. Anyone else? Hopeless.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hey, now, don't look like that, Closure. All I can do is remain at Rhodes Island. I count as one of you. When I want to hack someone apart, let me out to war, and it'll be a win for you too.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So, are you able to accept continued combat as a Rhodes Island Operator?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I told you, the battlefield is where I can find some peace and quiet inside my head. I can't work like I did as an Abyssal Hunter anymore, but aboard Rhodes Island, there are those who let me revel in the fighting front.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So you mean to say, our commander gives you effective instruction?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: In fact, once I'm done with you, that is where I plan to go.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: We've never talked while I was awake. I've got a few things I need to explain, quickly.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Rhodes Island's commander—the Doctor, is nothing like any of you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You can tell.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: When language can't reach, all the other senses become stronger as a result. If I want to continue fighting...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I must... bring the Doctor... to that place...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Specter...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...*hiss*. I can't stop now, or else the darkness will catch me up.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I need to go.

a.text: Specter runs... no, it more resembles a wandering onto dry land.
That mad chatter echoes, eating away at her nerves.
There's not a moment when the high-concentration liquid Originium poured into her spinal cord isn't repelling, invading her body, restored by Specter's own cells afterwards.
The flesh can still persist, but the spirit is not the same.
The Church used crueler, more wicked means than all to utterly perturb her thought.
Outside the true Laurentina, wraps 'Specter.'
Laurentina... and Specter at the same time. It has taken time endless, but in the end, she chooses to accept it whole.
The fact she no longer tears at her nun's clothing tells it all.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Ah... ah... I've found you...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Good day... Doctor...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heheh. This is my first time talking to you awake...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Yes... awake. I am still awake right now, but I am also... somewhat fatigued.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Relax, Doctor. You are already used to this sort of conversation with me. Now, you may understand me even better.

options: There's so much I want to ask you.
What are you willing to tell me?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Doctor... you have seen me before as I washed about, spoken with me.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: If there were words then that you could not comprehend, do not... do not heed them.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Those madnesses should not be passed on, but it is beyond me to control it. Fortunately, I still have the right to silence.

options: You need to say it. You want to speak.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heheh, Doctor, there are so few who should be willing to try.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: My one regret is, in that form, I am unable to sing. And I... the I of now, no longer have the voice for song...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Doctor... I will sing you a song.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I must sing it. And then... you have... some kind of power. I believe, after you hear this, you may be able to understand.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Doctor, I have met my colleagues. My captain... as Abyssal Hunters, we endured selection of the prime, elimination of the unfit, uncountable times.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Gladiia once commanded us to jointly resist that terrifying enemy... the darkness from within the ocean. She remains the same even now.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But I. I am the name 'Shark,' yet have become 'Specter.' Akin with Skadi, we carry the odor of dry land. We carry the scent Rhodes Island carries.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Doctor, in the times I cannot maintain wakefulness, I cannot swim together with my captain... my body has been implanted with makings of dry land, and I am forced only to crawl across this world.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I thirst, thirst to stand upon the battlefield, thirst to enter the sea, thirst to sing.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You are the tactical commander... on the battlefield, you know, the way in which I fight. Do not let me leave the battlefield for too long. That is my... evidence, that I live after others die.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Put even more danger upon my share.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Then let me a little closer to the enemy. Do not worry, Doctor, I'll be more obedient on the battlefield than ever before.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Do not fear my strength... simply keep far from me, what you do not want my saw to cut.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Fundamentally, an Abyssal Hunter's battle needs no surplus communication.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Worry not, Doctor. Break us in for a bit longer, and we will only become more familiar with each other, and the bindings of language... will have no meaning at all to fighters like us.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Should I trust you, commander of dry land?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: To allow me to fight like an Abyssal Hunter, allow me to fight more and more... so that my faint consciousness returns to these hands of mine, power overflowing, weapon in their grasp?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Heh, heheh, hahahah...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Observe, Doctor, I still have so many 'secrets,' and I will be sure to tell them to you, before you go to that place...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But now, but now, just what ought I do...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Sing... yes, sing.

a.text: When she prayed♪
The stars ceased to shimmer♪
Specter seems utterly content with the scene before her. She breaks into a laugh, and serenely laughs away.
Humming those old, mysterious refrains, a body on the waves leaves the Doctor's sight.
And when she wept♪
The night let out a smile♪

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: This... Specter can sing.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Specter?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And when she wept♪

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The night let out a smile♪

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Specter... Laurentina, stand still.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: A colleague's scent... oh...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Specter, can... you hear me speak? Specter—

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Don't touch... me...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You have not... undergone baptism... return your filth to the ocean... the breath of dry land repels you... seduces you...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hahh... I hear your call... hahh... the edge of the darkness...

a.text: The hunter Skadi silently follows behind her, a distance left between them.
Set in her walk forwards, Specter does not heed her again.
In spells, she mutters to herself, then sings out loud, fully complacent reveling in her madness—in the tranquility within.
Skadi thinks, at the very least, she once again knows how to sing.
And as she lamented♪
The anguish sprawled upon her madness♪
And as she lamented♪
The anguish sprawled upon her madness♪
